messages.text: How do changes in AI data centers technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

AI / data-center infrastructure changes are described as moving across connectivity, power, and resilience, with full-spectrum connectivity covering high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power distribution, busbar, liquid cooling, and leak detection [3][79].
High-speed electrical connectivity is described with OSFP cable assemblies from 25G/lane NRZ up to 224G/lane PAM4 and aggregate bandwidths of 200G, 400G, 800G, and 1.6T per cable assembly [1].
AI server PCB changes are described as pushing PCB toward high layer count, large area, and high-speed transmission, with low-Dk, low-loss, high-thermal materials, 30–40 layers, and 12–14× aspect ratio process challenges [83].
R&S PCB test solutions list measurement items such as TDR impedance, DK/DF extraction, insertion loss, roughness, crosstalk, transmission-line modeling, eye diagram, sampling testing, and process monitoring [6].
The AI server R&S solution mapping places R&S ZNA / ZNB into PCB IL and TDR, connector / cable high-speed cable testing, and ZNA into PCBA high-speed trace and GPU TDR contexts [9][73].
The same mapping places R&S FSWP into LDO noise spectral density, clock jitter, and jitter / phase-noise testing contexts [8].
For signaling testers, R&S CMX500 is described as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD device testing [19].
R&S CMX500 also provides NR FR1 / FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling, WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, and PER measurement [19].
For Wi-Fi 7 R&D, signaling-mode testing requires measuring RF TX / RX characteristics under real-world conditions, and MLO makes multiple RF chains important [25].
Wi-Fi 7-specific signaling tests listed include 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and E2E capabilities [25].
For Wi-Fi 8 signaling, the source describes a shift from sheer speed toward ultra-high reliability and lists new testing hurdles including distributed resource units and unequal modulation [30].
For non-signaling production testing, the Wi-Fi 7 source maps R&S CMP180 to production non-signaling RF testing [26].
【推論】If the Signaling Tester is used for wireless devices connected to the data-center ecosystem, its capability needs to track multi-technology WLAN / cellular signaling, RF TX/RX, MLO, MIMO, coexistence, throughput, BLER/PER, and newer Wi-Fi 8 dRU / UEQM features [19][25][30].
【推論】For the Non-signaling Tester, the passages only support a Wi-Fi 7 production RF role for R&S CMP180, and they do not provide AI data-center-specific non-signaling measurement requirements [26][27].

AI 資料中心高壓直流供電 › 800 V 到低壓供電路徑
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）研究兩種關鍵轉換路徑：`800 V → 54 V` 與 `800 V → 12 V`。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）稱，三級架構先將 `800 V` 降至 `54 V`，再經由 [[IBC]] 與 [[VRM]] 功率級或背面 [[垂直供電]] 模組進一步降壓，可降低 [[PDN]] 損耗，並支援 IBC 與 VRM 級均位於夾層卡上的方案。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）稱，二級架構 `800 V → 12 V` 可省去一個完整功率轉換級，節省主板空間。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）稱，Infineon 開發 `800 V → 12 V` 的 `6 kW` 示範板，功率密度超過 `2300 W/in³`。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）指出，`800 V → 12 V` 示範板採用對稱布局，由兩組堆疊式 LLC 變換器組成，並採用矩陣變壓器結構。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）指出，`800 V → 12 V` 示範板初級側採用 `650 V` [[CoolGaN]] 技術，次級側使用 `40 V` 矽基 [[OptiMOS]] 6 系列。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）指出，[[PSOC]] MCU 與 [[EiceDriver]] gate driver 提供 PWM 與驅動信號。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）稱，`800 V → 12 V` 轉換器測試結果為峰值效率 `97.4%`、滿載效率 `96.6%`。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）另探索 `800 V → 50 V → 6 V`，其中 `800 V → 50 V` 堆疊式 LLC 變換級在諧振頻率下工作，峰值效率達 `98.5%`。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）稱，[[Hybrid Switched Capacitor]] 拓撲結合磁能與電容能量傳遞，用於中壓 [[IBC]] 將電壓進一步降至 `6 V`。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）稱，Infineon 正在開發額定功率 `1 kW`、固定 `8:1` 轉換比的電源模組，用於將現有 `48 V/50 V` 電壓域轉換至 `6 V` 中間匯流排。
- [[SST(Solid State Transformer ) image 1]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）只標示 Data Center 側 **800 VDC**；來源未提供 `800 V → 54 V`、`800 V → 12 V`、`800 V → 50 V → 6 V` 或晶片端低壓轉換路徑。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox › Testing phases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 將測試階段放在下列脈絡中：

- [[Go-NoGo Testing]]。
- [[Non-Sig Testing]]。
- [[Conformance Testing]]。
- [[R&D Testing]]。

來源未明確說這四者是完整 lifecycle，也未定義各階段 pass/fail 標準。

CMX500 Callbox › UI 與 automation
來源將 [[CMsquares]] 描述為 web based、all-in-one configuration、all tools in one place、modern UI，並列出：

- live views。
- App Testing。
- NTN live views。
- Sequencer。
- Log analysis。
- One-click RF testing。

在 RF pre-conformance 脈絡中，來源稱可 quick switch from manual to automated pre-conformance，且使用 same technology specific license，並指向 [[CMX500 Sequencer Test Packages]] 與 `Sequencer-CMX-Test_Packages_Database.xlsx`。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 支撐。
- 來源是 PR / demonstration positioning，不是正式 datasheet、configuration guide、test case list 或 certification document。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi 7 的 option code、software release、支援 RF chains 數量、MLO link combination、measurement uncertainty 或完整 test coverage。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMP180]] 480 MHz waveform 的正式 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 標準地位、量測規格或 production throughput。

Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity › 與既有知識的關係
- 既有 [[R&S CMX500]] 頁已依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 記錄 WLAN signaling 802.11bn options 與 WLAN TX measurement option family；本新聞稿提供 PR / demonstration 層級的 [[Wi-Fi 8]] RF signaling tests 與 Broadcom prototype device 展示語境。
- 既有 [[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]]、[[Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap OTA measurements]] 與 [[4G 5G NR WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing]] 聚焦 Wi‑Fi 7 / IEEE 802.11be、OTA chamber integration 與 Bluetest / EMITE；本來源轉向 [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] RF signaling tests，不是 OTA chamber 測試。
- 既有 [[Broadcom]] 頁主要收錄 Broadcom 在 switch、PCIe switch 與 TPU roadmap 圖表中的列名；本來源新增 Broadcom 作為 prototype Wi-Fi 8 device 提供方 / 展示合作方的 PR 語境。
- 本來源屬於 [[Productions]] 資料，但不是 datasheet / configuration guide；不可用來取代 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 或 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 的正式規格與 option ordering data。

Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests › 來源中的測試情境
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]：

Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests › 與 Wi-Fi 7 OTA 測試的區分
本頁不同於 [[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]]：

- [[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]] 目前由 Bluetest / EMITE OTA chamber PR 支撐，聚焦 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] over-the-air chamber workflow。
- [[Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests]] 目前由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] / [[Broadcom]] PR 支撐，聚焦 [[R&S CMX500]] signaling mode、[[Wi-Fi 8]] PHY features 與 prototype Broadcom WLAN device。

Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap OTA measurements › 來源中的測試架構
依 [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]]：

- [[EMITE]] over-the-air chambers 可與 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 的 latest sophisticated testing features combined。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 multi-technology、multi-channel one-box signaling tester。
- cellular technologies：[[LTE]]、[[5G NR]] [[NR FR1]] frequency range up to 8 GHz、[[NR FR2]] millimeter wave frequency range up to 50 GHz、latest [[5G RedCap]]。
- non-cellular technologies：latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]。
- integration enables support of LTE、FR1、FR2、full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] and [[5G RedCap]]。
- EMITE customers obtain a comprehensive environment for accurately assessing performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] and [[5G RedCap]] devices。

Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap OTA measurements
[[Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap OTA measurements]] 是 [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 中描述的 OTA 測試解決方案情境：將 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 latest test capabilities 整合到 [[EMITE]] over-the-air chambers，以評估 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 與 [[5G RedCap]] devices 的 performance。

- 來源未標示發布日期。

MVG OTA test systems now support full WLAN OTA signaling testing alongside cellular coverage with CMX500 OBT from Rohde & Schwarz › 重點摘要
- [[MVG]]（Microwave Vision Group）已將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 full WLAN signaling test functionality，包括 [[Wi-Fi 7]]，整合進 [[WaveStudio Software Suite]]。
- 來源稱此整合讓 wireless and mobile device manufacturers 可在 single antenna measurement system 中執行 comprehensive 4G、5G 與 [[WLAN]] [[OTA testing]]。
- [[WaveStudio Software Suite]] 整合的是 [[R&S CMX500]] / [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 full Wi‑Fi（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be）access point and station testing functionality。
- 來源明確新增：software now supports [[5G NR Non-Standalone]]（[[EN-DC]]）testing with the [[R&S CMX500]]。
- 來源稱這些擴充使 [[MVG]] multiprobe measurement systems 可在 single tester 內 fully support Wi‑Fi and cellular standards，包括 [[5G NR Standalone]]（SA）、[[5G NR Non-Standalone]]（EN-DC）、[[RedCap]] 與 [[LTE]]（FDD & TDD）。
- [[Pierre Jurek]] 以 [[MVG]] Deputy Chief Executive Officer 身分表示，整合 WLAN testing 與進一步擴充 cellular testing capabilities 是 significant milestone，讓客戶可用 one [[R&S CMX500]] signaling tester 在 [[MVG]] OTA test systems 中測試 all essential current transmission standards。
- [[Christoph Pointner]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Senior Vice President of Mobile Radio Testers 身分表示，使用 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] in an [[MVG]] multiprobe OTA measurement system 的 manufacturers 可最大化 [[R&S CMX500]] extensive test functions，支援所有 WLAN standards including latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]，並支援 4G 與 5G mobile signals。
- 來源連回前一份合作背景新聞稿 [[MVG integrates CMX500 OBT into WaveStudio Software Suite, simplifying 5G OTA signaling test processes]]。
- [[MVG]] 公司背景段落與前一份來源一致：提供 electromagnetic waves visualization、antenna characterization、radar signature evaluation 與 electromagnetic measurements 方案；營運於 10 個國家；90% sales from exports；Group revenues exceeding €100 million。

FR3 13 GHz 5G NR connection demonstration › CMX500 OBT 在來源中的角色
來源稱 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 是 future-proof multi-technology, multi-channel one-box signaling tester，且其 versatility allows for easy adaptation to different [[NR]] numerologies，因此適合 [[FR3]] research and development。

- Create a signaling environment by transmitting an [[FR3]] cell signal at 13 GHz, simulating real-world conditions。
- Conduct comprehensive analysis, verifying the device's ability to achieve maximum throughput in the [[FR3]] frequency range。

FR3 13 GHz 5G NR connection demonstration › 使用限制

- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）稱，隨著 GPU 功耗上升與每機架 GPU 叢集規模擴大，單機架功率需求將很快突破 `1 MW` 或更高。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）稱，當單機架功率達 MW 等級，系統架構必須從既有 `48 V` 生態系轉向高壓直流供電。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）預計，從 `48 V` 匯流排架構轉向 `800 V` 或 [[±400Vdc]] 架構，會在單機架功率達 `200 kW` 至 `250 kW` 時出現。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）指出，在 `48 V` 匯流排架構下，單機架功率 `200 kW` 至 `250 kW` 對應母排電流約 `4100 A` 至 `5200 A`。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）提出高壓直流架構示例：採用 `800 V DC` 的集中發電與高壓直流配電，並在伺服器主板進行本地功率轉換。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）稱，未來伺服器主板將直接運行於 `800 V` 或 [[±400Vdc]] 電壓。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）指出，高壓直流伺服器主板需要在插入高壓直流匯流排前執行預充電，並在伺服器主板從 IT 機架移除時確保開關及時放電，以避免危險電壓。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）指出，每個伺服器主板需部署 [[eFuse]] 功能，以便故障時快速切斷電源。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）展示基於 [[XDP]] 熱插拔控制器 `XDP70x` 與 [[CoolSiC]] [[JFET]] 的 [[eFuse]] 與 hot-swap 控制方案；實驗條件為輸入電容 `300 µF`，可將伺服器主板從 `0 V` 預充電至 `800 V`。

AI / data-center infrastructure changes are described as moving across connectivity, power, and resilience, with full-spectrum connectivity covering high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power distribution, busbar, liquid cooling, and leak detection [3][79].
High-speed electrical connectivity is described with OSFP cable assemblies from 25G/lane NRZ up to 224G/lane PAM4 and aggregate bandwidths of 200G, 400G, 800G, and 1.6T per cable assembly [1].
AI server PCB changes are described as pushing PCB toward high layer count, large area, and high-speed transmission, with low-Dk, low-loss, high-thermal materials, 30–40 layers, and 12–14× aspect ratio process challenges [83].
R&S PCB test solutions list measurement items such as TDR impedance, DK/DF extraction, insertion loss, roughness, crosstalk, transmission-line modeling, eye diagram, sampling testing, and process monitoring [6].
The AI server R&S solution mapping places R&S ZNA / ZNB into PCB IL and TDR, connector / cable high-speed cable testing, and ZNA into PCBA high-speed trace and GPU TDR contexts [9][73].
The same mapping places R&S FSWP into LDO noise spectral density, clock jitter, and jitter / phase-noise testing contexts [8].
For signaling testers, R&S CMX500 is described as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD device testing [19].
R&S CMX500 also provides NR FR1 / FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling, WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, and PER measurement [19].
For Wi-Fi 7 R&D, signaling-mode testing requires measuring RF TX / RX characteristics under real-world conditions, and MLO makes multiple RF chains important [25].
Wi-Fi 7-specific signaling tests listed include 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and E2E capabilities [25].
For Wi-Fi 8 signaling, the source describes a shift from sheer speed toward ultra-high reliability and lists new testing hurdles including distributed resource units and unequal modulation [30].
For non-signaling production testing, the Wi-Fi 7 source maps R&S CMP180 to production non-signaling RF testing [26].
【推論】If the Signaling Tester is used for wireless devices connected to the data-center ecosystem, its capability needs to track multi-technology WLAN / cellular signaling, RF TX/RX, MLO, MIMO, coexistence, throughput, BLER/PER, and newer Wi-Fi 8 dRU / UEQM features [19][25][30].
【推論】For the Non-signaling Tester, the passages only support a Wi-Fi 7 production RF role for R&S CMP180, and they do not provide AI data-center-specific non-signaling measurement requirements [26][27].

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位

- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。

Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity › 重點摘要

- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱在最終 IEEE standard ratification 之前，已將 first [[Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests]] 實作到 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester。
- 展示情境：[[MWC Barcelona 2026]]，[[Rohde & Schwarz]] booth 5A80，Fira Gran Via Barcelona，hall 5。
- 測試對象：[[Broadcom]] prototype next-generation WLAN device / prototype [[Wi-Fi 8]] device。
- [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的焦點被描述為從 sheer speed 轉向 ultra-high reliability（[[UHR]]）performance。
- 來源稱 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 延續 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 的 core PHY parameters：supported frequencies up to 7.125 GHz、channel bandwidths up to 320 MHz、4096QAM modulation、[[MLO]]。

- UEQM analysis 被描述為可評估 test device 是否能依 specified modulation coding scheme（MCS）combinations 正確 adapt modulation。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被定位為 modular、powerful one-box signaling tester，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR]] SA/NSA、[[NR-NTN]]、[[NB-NTN]]、Direct-to-Cell（[[D2C]] / [[DTC]]）與 WLAN including [[Wi‑Fi 7]] and [[Wi‑Fi 8]]。
- Press & media contact：[[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement。
